semantic_checks: Common definition uses finite nonempty tagged catalog, unit customers/providers, ordered pure-SPE all-history IC; no count-function strategy restriction.

The assigned object is only a finite necessary-row cone. Exact dual eta is nonnegative on every enumerated column, not merely saved support; all 342 row slacks and 7936 column remainders are retained.

All four exact duals use copy/copy-opt/menu-G rows only (PAIR multipliers are zero); each recovered primal point has every PAIR row slack strictly positive, so adding these PAIR rows leaves this specified cone optimum unchanged.

The ell endpoint identity is affine in ell for fixed (e,d), so ell=0,m generates the same nonnegative column cone as ell=0,...,m. This is a cone statement and does not assert a common legal catalog or SPE realization after splitting.

The exact beta values are finite-cone optima and imply W>=OPT_m/beta for real SPEs through necessary rows, but do not prove full strategy realization, a universal half theorem, or a strongest-bound claim.
